chapters.title: Chapter 3: Using Knowledge to Improve the World

episode.tagline: Our universities are broken. The academy is a circlejerk. Our intellectuals have failed us. To nurture a Knowledge Society, we need to rethink how we make knowledge, how we diffuse it, and how we use it to make the world a better place.
